Title: New regions in Brazil Southeast for Azure Database for MySQL

Body.Content: To provide customers the best in class experience for managed open source database offerings, we are announcing general availability support of Azure Database for MySQL in the Brazil Southeast region. Now you have additional flexibility in deploying solutions to help accelerate innovation and better support you working to transform businesses. For current information about regional availability of Azure database services for MySQL see products available by region.
